§5I§0 can’t fucking 
believe this. 

§5I§0 pull the drenched fabric up out of the water immediately. 

§5I§0 can’t see the state it's in properly, but even soaking wet and probably ruined §5I§0 can still identify the coat the moment §5I§0 feel it.

§5I§0 need to check it out. §5I§0 must make sure 
it's okay. 

Without any hesitation, §5I§0 start trudging through the water back to the steps. 

§5My§0 camera does a poor job and highlighting where §5I’m§0 going, but it’s much better than being

totally blind. 

§5I§0 have half a mind to put it on right now, but that would be a terrible idea. 

Just as §5I§0 reach the steps, §5I§0 glance down the hallway with the thermal camera. 


Holy shit.

There’s two doors on the left side, one door on the right, and a door at the very end. 

The door at 
the end is hot. 

The other two doors are  barely distinguishable blocks of gray, the only reason §5I§0 can even see them is because

the metal knobs seem to reflect just a bit of §5my§0 own heat back, but the door at the end is bright white. 

Do §5I§0 check out 
the door? 

Fuck. 
Fuck this. 
Fuck it. 

§5I§0 place the coat onto

the stairs, and §5I §0approach the door. 

As §5I§0 walk the hallway, the water becomes much more shallow. 

It seems this place 
is tilted, and the 
water is collecting 
on the other side 
in that room. 

§5I§0 put §5my§0 free hand up

to the door. 

It doesn’t feel different, despite the camera telling §5me§0 it should be noticeably hot. §5My§0 hand is dull gray in comparison to the knob’s bright white on the screen. 

§5I§0 grab the knob. It’s actually cool to the touch. What the fuck is

going on? The knob twists fine, and there’s nothing interesting about its feel. 

The camera is lying to §5me§0, apparently. 

The knob twists, and §5I§0 push the door open. Faint light pours in to the hallway, and §5I§0 can finally fucking see.

The relief of having real vision again is brutally ripped away from §5me§0 when §5I§0 see both what’s on the other side of the door, and the environment around §5me§0. 

The other side of the door reveals the room §5I§0 woke up in.

Alongside this, the water has completely disappeared. 

A force from behind shoves §5me§0 into the door, and the door slams shut behind §5me§0. 

§5My§0 head slams onto the ground, and the camera skitters under the bed that I woke up on.

There’s no evidence of any water on the ground, save for §5my§0 soaking wet shoes. 

§5I§0 shake off the impact, and look around §5me§0.

Same blank walls, same bed, same doorway, same door hanging out into the hall from when §5I§0 tried kicking it open.

§5I’m§0 in another 
fucking closed loop. 

§5I§0 start to break down. 
§5I§0 weep, stricken with horror and and dread at the realization §5I’m§0 trapped somewhere else, somewhere awful and dark and depressing, it fucking smells awful and it’s soaking wet, water

everywhere. The air is noxious and humid, and it’s so uncomfortable. 

§5I§0 feel so suffocated. §5I’m§0 trapped here. 


No. Knock this off.

§5I§0 shake §5myself§0 out of §5my§0 despair. 

Anger wells up in §5me§0.

I’ll find a way out of here if §5I§0 have to tear this place apart. 

§5I§0 am not going to be fucking trapped here. 

§5I§0 storm out of the room, and down the hall. 

§5I§0 approach the door at the end of the hall. When that bump

downstairs interrupted §5me§0. 
   Startled  §5me§0. Frightened  §5me§0. 

§5I’m§0 too pissed 
to be afraid now. 

§5I§0 grab the knob 
to the door, and 
it doesn’t budge. 


Fuck you.

§5I§0 step back, coil §5my§0 muscles, and prepare to kick it down. 


Nothing cares to open it for §5me§0 this time, and §5my§0 heel meets the wood. 

The bang of §5my§0 foot against the door rings out through the house.

§5I§0 wind up again. 

Another kick. 

§5I§0 grunt and groan, slamming again and again, furiously pounding at the 
wood, the hinges sound like they’re going to give out 
any second, and 
then they do.

The door falls in, slamming against the back wall. 

The room is very small, only about 4 feet back, and 5 feet wide. 

It looks like a bathroom. 

Splinters of wood from §5my§0 assault on

the door cover 
the floor. 

The door itself has a massive dent where §5my§0 foot hit repeatedly. 

§5I§0 don’t feel any better. 

§5I§0 just feel more pissed off. 

Inspecting the room

reveals nothing to §5me§0. 
This was a waste of time, a waste of energy and effort. 

§5I§0 turn to leave the room, and am stopped in §5my§0 tracks. 

Just as §5my§0 head adjusts from the shifting of §5my§0 body, §5I§0 see some sort of

face around the corner dart down the stairs. 

§5My§0 blood runs cold.
